fusions.name: Flicked Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes out up to 5 tiles, dealing 4 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at full reach, and sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Splashdown
fusions.desc: You spring onto a target up to 7 tiles away and land in a burst of flame that deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Swamp Gas Bubble
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to sink a bubble of swamp gas at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles ignites it: it deals 20 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Coiled Spring
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
